integrity: Analytic proof and standalone reproducibility checker; finite quadrature corroborates but cannot certify infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Quenched single-draw absolutely continuous period law and scalar light/dark kinetic reduction only; second-order covariance limit is ordered time then lag; no renewed-cycle stochastic forcing or direct experimental validation. Generic phase-mixing principles preexist.
title: A strictly positive long-lag covariance plateau for randomly timed photosynthetic cycles
